youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Psalm 19:14 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Pray this one before you say anything to anybody.

"Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer." Psalm 19:14 (KJV)

Your words today will either build somebody up or tear them down. Let him pick them.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
